title: Mangrove Roots Crafting
description: Craft sticks and mangrove planks from Mangrove Roots!
body:
## Craft sticks and mangrove planks from Mangrove Roots!

Too many Mangrove Roots and not enough planks for your builds and crafting?
Now you can convert them!

**Crafting recipes include:**
- 2 Mangrove roots for 4 sticks
- 4 Mangrove roots for 4 Mangrove planks

Balance: I tested Mangrove Roots against other items to compare fuel weight and found that roots are the same as planks as a fuel source. I used this comparison in deciding the crafting amounts for both recipes.
